tools.name: get_location_search
tools.description: Turn a place name into coordinates, an IANA timezone and a DST-aware UTC offset, across 235,000+ cities and towns in 240+ countries. Coverage reaches rural towns of a few hundred people and every administrative seat, so a birthplace outside a major metro resolves as reliably as a capital. Matching i

tools.name: get_location_countries
tools.description: Returns every country with ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 and alpha-3 codes, plus the number of searchable cities per country. Use this endpoint to build country dropdown menus, regional filters, or to check city coverage before querying a birth location. Countries are sorted alphabetically by name. Covers Euro

tools.name: get_location_countries_iso2
tools.description: Returns all cities for a specific country, identified by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. DE for Germany, FR for France, GB for United Kingdom, US for United States). Each city includes geographic coordinates, IANA timezone, and DST-aware UTC offset for direct use in astrology birth chart, horoscope, t

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_location_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "City autocomplete and geocoding search across 23,000+ locations in 240+ countries, including deep coverage of Indian tier-2 and tier-3 cities. Returns geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude), IANA timezone, and DST-aware UTC offset for each match. Built for birth chart location pickers, horosco" → after: "Turn a place name into coordinates, an IANA timezone and a DST-aware UTC offset, across 235,000+ cities and towns in 240+ countries. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
